title: Count Pairs With XOR in a Range
description: Given an integer array `nums` and two integers `low` and `high`, return the number of index pairs `(i, j)` with `0 <= i < j < nums.length` such that `low <= (nums[i] XOR nums[j]) <= high`.
hints: Transform the range query `[low, high]` into `countLess(high + 1) - countLess(low)`, where `countLess(limit)` counts pairs whose XOR is strictly less than `limit`.

Insert numbers one by one into a bitwise Trie (most significant bit first) storing subtree counts; when bit `b` of `limit` is 1, all previously inserted numbers matching bit `b` of `x` yield XOR bit 0 and can be counted immediately.

examples.explanation: With a single element, there are 0 pairs.
